senses.gloss: f. (חָסַם I) muzzling, the law forbidding muzzling (Deut. XXV, 4).
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 88b:9">B. Mets. 88ᵇ</cite> <he>אתה מצווה על חֲסִימָתוֹ</he> thou art warned not to muzzle him.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 89a:1">Ib. 89ᵃ</cite> <he>כל מילי איתנהו בח׳</he> all things (animals) are implied in the law &c.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 90b:6">Ib. 90ᵇ</cite> <he>ח׳ מעלייתא הוא</he> it is a real case of muzzling; a. fr.
